Banana Choc Chip Muffin4
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:21am

Ingredients




2 Extra-ripe bananas
2 Eggs
1 cup Brown sugar, packed
1/4 cup Oil
1 teaspoon Vanilla
2 1/4 cups All-purpose flour
2 teaspoons Baking powder
1/2 teaspoon Ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1 cup Chocolate chips
1/2 cup Walnuts, chopped
1/4 cup Yogurt, plain or vanilla

Preparation

1 Puree bananas in blender (1 cup). In med. bowl, beat pureed bananas, eggs, sugar, butter and vanilla until well blended. In large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Stir in choc. chips and nuts. Make well in center of dry ingredients. Pour in banana mixture. Mix until just blended. Spoon into well-greased 2 1/2-inch muffin cups. Bake in 350 deg. 2 Oven 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from pan. 3 Makes about 12 muffins.
